documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
INTIMATION FOR RESCHEDULING OF 60TH ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING OF THE COMPANY ON 26TH AUGUST 2026 (WEDNESDAY) AT 12:00 NOON (IST)

analysis.summary: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q4 and FY26, achieving a highest-ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT and record production levels across key products. The gross refining margin for FY26 stood at $9.2 per barrel, while the Q4 GRM was $13.75 per barrel. Management highlighted a strong balance sheet with a low net debt-to-equity ratio of 0.09 and announced a total dividend of INR62 per share for the year. The company is actively pursuing new capex projects, including Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS and retail outlets. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited reported its Q4 FY25 and full year financial and operational performance, highlighting strong physical throughput despite scheduled maintenance shutdowns.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the maintenance CAPEX for the next year will be in the range of Rs. 200-250 crore.
guidance.quote: Our maintenance CAPEX remains Rs. 200-250 crore range, and the next year forecast also, we feel the CAPEX will be in that range.

guidance.claim: Management expects the CCEA approval for the CBR project in a few months.
guidance.quote: We are awaiting CCEA approval, that process is on, and we expect it in few months.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that Motor Spirit (MS) in the southern market has a clear shortfall where production is less than demand by close to 20 TMT per month.
demand_outlook.quote: MS in southern market, there is a clear shortfall so, the production is less than demand. It is close to about 20 TMT per month.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that the southern market's demand for MS is projected around 4%-5% growth compared to national growth projections of 6%.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as others are concerned, we have seen the southern market to be mostly aligned to the national growth projection. Like MS, they are projecting 6% and here we see around 4%-5%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that HSD growth is forecasted at 3% in the southern market against 2.5% nationally.
demand_outlook.quote: HSD we see at 3% growth forecast, as against 2.5% odd here.

capex_expansion.claim: The company stated that the Group 2 and Group 3 LOBS project is budgeted at INR1,600 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: LOBS project, Group 2, Group 3 LOBS project is INR1,600 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management noted that the retail outlet project is budgeted at INR400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The retail outlet project is INR400 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that normal maintenance capex is assumed at another INR500 crores every year.
capex_expansion.quote: Besides, every year, you can assume another INR500 crores is our normal capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent Rs. 673 crores as capital expenditure for the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: On the CAPEX front, in the current year, we have spent Rs. 673 crores as CAPEX for the current year.

capex_expansion.claim: The revised capital cost for the CBR project is Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian Oil.
capex_expansion.quote: The revised capital cost is at Rs. 36,354 crores with a 25:75 equity holding between CPCL and Indian oil respectively.

capex_expansion.claim: CPCL has full custody of the land for the CBR project, possessing approximately 600 acres already held and another 600 acres newly acquired.
capex_expansion.quote: The most important updates with respect to the project is now we have full custody of the land. So, about 600 acres, which was already with CPCL and another 600 acres, which was acquired in the process, both is in our possession and the pre-project activities of boundary wall construction, and all those things are almost at a big stage.

capex_expansion.claim: The new CBR refinery project is planned with a 9 million metric ton capacity and a petrochemical intensity of 6% for polypropylene.
capex_expansion.quote: The new refinery capital cost is Rs 36,000 Crore approximately, 9 million metric ton capacity and petrochemical intensity of 6% and which is PP, polypropylene.

margins_costs.claim: The gross refining margin for the fourth quarter was $13.75 per barrel.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for quarter 4 was $13.75 barrel as compared to Singapore benchmark of $8.70 per barrel, which again reiterates that all these efficiencies are constant, continuous and are being sustained over each period.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported a core GRM of $10.3 per barrel for the fourth quarter.
The full year GRM for 2024-25 stood at $4.22 per barrel compared to $8.64 per barrel in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: The GRM for 2024-25 for a full year basis is $4.22 per barrel as compared to the previous year $8.64 per barrel, but if you compare it to Singapore benchmark which was $3.79 per barrel in the current year, we have performed better.

margins_costs.claim: The Q4 FY25 GRM was $6.22 per barrel compared to $7.7 per barrel in the same quarter of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: On Quarter 4, our GRM was $6.22 per barrel. Again, if I compare the previous year same quarter, it was $7.7 per barrel, but if I compare it to Singapore benchmark, which was only $3.1 per barrel.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gain for the fourth quarter was $0.66 per barrel, amounting to Rs. 125 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory gain is not very significant for the quarter. It is only $ 0.66 per barrel. And in absolute rupee terms, it is Rs. 125 crores only.

margins_costs.claim: For the full annual basis, the inventory showed a loss of $0.06 per barrel, or Rs. 40 crores.
margins_costs.quote: But on an overall annual basis, the inventory would be a loss that is $ 0.06 per barrel, Rs. 40 crores in amount.

margins_costs.claim: Fuel and loss for the year came down to 8.51%.
margins_costs.quote: and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported operating expenditure (net) of 1,085 Crore for 2022-23, 1,215 Crore for 2023-24, and 945 Crore for 9M 2024-25.
Singapore GRM was stated as $10.70/bbl for 2022-23, $6.58/bbl for 2023-24, and $4.02/bbl for 9M 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 million metric tons during the financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a highest ever crude throughput of 11.71 MMT, million metric ton, which equivalents to 112% of installed capacity, breaking records of our previous best of 11.64 MMT achieved in financial year 2023-'24.

orders_capacity.claim: Crude throughput for the fourth quarter was 2.93 MMT, representing 111% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: In quarter 4 of the current financial year, CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 2.93 MMT, which is also 111% of installed capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT for the year, equivalent to 99.5% of its installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: CPCL achieved a crude throughput of 10.45 MMT, equivalent to 99.5% of our installed capacity and this must be seen with respect to the turnaround that has happened during the year

orders_capacity.claim: For Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974 MMT, representing 113% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: and coming on to Quarter 4, the crude throughput was 2.974, which is 113% of installed capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The gross borrowings stand at INR1,900 crores and net borrowings at INR973 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: On a gross basis, the borrowings are INR1,900 crores, but on a net basis, it is less than INR1,000 crores, to be precise, INR973 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: we are happy to announce that in addition to the interim dividend of INR8 per equity share of INR10 each, the Board has recommended a final dividend of INR54 per share, taking the total dividend for the year to INR62 per share, which again is highest ever.

capital_allocation.claim: Capital expenditure for the current year was INR856 crores compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the current year, the capex was INR856 crores as compared to INR673 crores in the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: Total absolute debt as of March 31, 2025, is Rs. 3,100 crores compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as of March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: At an absolute level, the debt stands at Rs. 3,100 crores as compared to Rs. 2,762 crores as on March 31, 2024.

capital_allocation.claim: Net worth as of March 31, 2025, stands at Rs. 7,939 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net worth is at Rs. 7,939 crores as on March 31, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share, representing 50% of the face value for the current year.
capital_allocation.quote: With the above, the Board has also recommended a dividend of Rs. 5 per equity share that is 50% of face value for the current year and as we all know, this is subject to approval at AGM, which will happen in the due course.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forex losses for the quarter were approximately INR200 crores and around INR350 crores for the full year.
risks_headwinds.quote: For the quarter, it would be for the quarter, it is approximately INR 200 crores,. And for the whole year, it will be around INR350 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices pose a challenge.
risks_headwinds.quote: Finally, the uncertainties due to volatility of crude prices do pose a challenge.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the INR2,000 crores total capex for LOBS and retail outlets will be deployed over 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: This INR2,000 crores will happen over 2 to 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that on a sustained basis, the company will bring fuel and loss indexes down to very efficient levels.
management_commitments.quote: we went to a roadmap where we said on a sustained basis, we will bring it down to very efficient levels and in that context, the fuel and loss has come down to 8.51% for the year as a whole.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated its commitment to develop new schemes on energy efficiency, take the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower, and develop enhanced production of value-added products.
management_commitments.quote: To summarize the physical performance, we are committed to develop new schemes on energy efficiency, take the fuel and loss reduction roadmap further lower and then develop enhanced production of value-added products as well going forward.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
